name: English
intro: We are a small law firm in the 4th district of Zurich. We specialize in assisting people in need, particularly those facing immigration and asylum issues, making advokatur kanonengasse a unique establishment.
In addition to our focus on immigration and asylum issues, we are happy to assist you with our expert knowledge in many other fields of law.
seoBeschreibung: advokatur kanonengasse, Militärstrasse 76, Zurich: a small law firm focusing on immigration and asylum, criminal, family and tenancy law. Phone hours Monday to Thursday.

ui.stockwerk: 1st floor, at the top of the stairs
anfahrtPunkte: Bus 31 from Zurich main station to the stop «Kanonengasse».
About five minutes on foot from the main station.

kapazitaetshinweis.text: Thank you for your enquiry. If you do not hear back from us within 24 hours, you may assume that none of our lawyers have sufficient capacity to take on your case.
